vibe_rationale: Community-run gathering with workshops, music and storytelling for a clearly defined lifestyle tribe; small and single-scene.
fit_notes: Outdoor, self-sufficient adult van-life crowd with a natural interest in health on the road, and a small, sold-out format. Outdoor and gear partners (Victron, Teva and others) already attend, so a sampling or workshop slot suits an Australian health brand. Partner tiers are unknown and 2027 dates are not announced.
